title: Install spaCR with Conda
description: Create a Conda environment, install spaCR from conda-forge and launch the application.
objectives: Create and activate a dedicated Conda environment.
Open spaCR and update the same environment when needed.
prerequisite: Install Conda or Miniforge, then open a terminal where the conda command is available.

scenes.narration: Open a Conda-enabled terminal. You will create an environment for spaCR, install the conda-forge package and launch the application from that environment.
Create an environment named spacr-conda with Python three point twelve. Choose another name if you already use that name for a different environment. Wait for Conda to finish creating it.
Activate spacr-conda. Run the displayed Python command to see the environment path, and check that it is the environment you just created.
Install spaCR from conda-forge using the displayed command. Review and accept Conda’s package plan, then let the download and installation finish. Run conda list spacr to see the installed version.
Check the installed spaCR version and package location. Keep that version with your analysis notes so you can return to the same environment later.
Run spacr-doctor if you want to check the installation. Read any warnings and follow the suggested steps for the file formats or features you need.
Enter spacr to launch the application. Complete any first-launch choices, then continue with the Home tutorial to find modules and their example data.
To update later, close spaCR, activate this environment and update the conda-forge package. Check the installed version afterwards. The pip and installer lessons cover the other installation routes.
